_comment: Copy this to config.json and edit local paths. config.json is ignored by git.

comfyui.description: Local ComfyUI server for image/video generation.
comfyui.setup_note: Set COMFYUI_DIR to your ComfyUI folder, or replace working_dir with a real path such as C:/AI/ComfyUI.

blkkstarhub.description: Status check for the app currently expected on localhost:3002.
blkkstarhub.setup_note: Starts apps/web-hub on port 3002 from the monorepo root.

openclaw.setup_note: OpenClaw has no default HTTP health URL here, so startup is reported by process launch.

unreal_mcp.description: Optional Unreal Engine 5.8 MCP endpoint. Open the UE editor manually unless you add a command.
unreal_mcp.setup_note: Enable when using UE 5.8 tours. Empty command means check only.
